chunks: Sulaymān ibn Khālid narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Beware of judging, for judgment belongs only to the Imam who is knowledgeable in judicial matters and just among the Muslims, like a prophet or the executor of a prophet.

key_terms.بِٱلْقَضَاءِ: in judicial matters and legal judgment
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامِ: the Imam vested with rightful authority

ai.seo_question: Who has the right to judge among the Muslims according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against assuming judicial authority without right. It states that judgment belongs only to the Imam who possesses knowledge of judicial matters and justice among the Muslims, reflecting the gravity of legitimate religious authority.
